Effective Cartier divisors in scheme versus algebraic-space chapters have differing inferred ambient settings and even different indexed premises.
A locally referenced equivalence F (equation-equivalence) is not necessarily the same functor in distinct chapters.
The expression equation-completion-functor is locally scoped and may denote a different functor in each chapter.
The referenced Cech functor equation is locally scoped to sites/cohomology versus cohomology.
Strictly perfect complexes live in potentially different ringed site/scheme contexts; explicit common ambient was not established.

fallback_separation_reason: Different source chapters/ambient mathematical categories, inherited local Situation/Definition/Equation references, or insufficient explicit context; statement-wording match alone does not establish logical identity.
provenance_policy: Retain all original Pass 1/2 records, all candidate IDs as aliases, all source citations, all distinct proof URLs as uninspected proof candidates. Only primary proof undergoes Pass 3 screen unless separately reviewed.
